item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Integrated Methodology for the Knowledge, Conservation and Adaptive Reuse of Historic Buildings - 2026_IDR_DICA_20 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-15 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-04 Geomatica

The research programme aims to define an integrated methodology for the knowledge, conservation and adaptive reuse of complex historic buildings, using the former Church of the Benedictines in Piacenza as a case study. The research seeks to integrate advanced geomatic surveying, HBIM modelling, historical and construction analysis, material diagnostics, and structural, geotechnical, energy and environmental assessments. Particular attention will be devoted to the integration of geometric, material and conservation data within the information model. item.description:

The research program investigates data-driven methodologies for the analysis, interpretation, and digital representation of the built environment. The research focuses on the analysis of BIM models and the standardization of information requirements for buildings with different uses, through the application of OpenBIM standards. Particular attention is given to the study of geometric configurations, representation languages, and interoperability among heterogeneous models. Activities involving the querying, integration, and visualization of multi-model data are planned, aimed at defining representation protocols capable of clarifying spatial, geometric, and informational relationships. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: “Environmental sustainability assessment of innovative processes to produce key components required for stem cell culture” - PROGRAMMA DI COOPERAZIONE INTERREG VI-A ITALIA–SVIZZERA (INSUBRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 12:00
Institution: INSUBRIA, Varese
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-02 Ingegneria sanitaria-ambientale, ingegneria e sicurezza degli scavi, delle materie prime, degli idrocarburi e fluidi nel sottosuolo

The research focuses on the sustainability analysis of processes aimed at developing alternative methods for producing the key components required for stem cell culture. Treatment steps and material flows will be defined, and primary data will be collected from other research partners. Quantitative inventory data will be organized to facilitate a material flow analysis and an environmental life cycle assessment (LCA) that encompasses the processes tested by the other partners. LCA software will be used to support the analysis.

The research activity focuses on the advanced numerical modeling of wave propagation and urban flooding in coastal settings vulnerable to marine inundations. The assignment includes the acquisition and integration of environmental and territorial data necessary for the characterization of the study scenarios. Such data will be obtained both from public sources (e.g., Copernicus services) and through dedicated monitoring campaigns conducted with in-situ and remote sensors. The research programme focuses on on-site investigation and structural and taxonomic survey of existing buildings stocks (school buildings, religious buildings), the development of models (information and numerical models) of selected case studies and monuments, the structural and seismic vulnerability analyses of such buildings, and the use of data derived from monitoring for the model calibration. Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

The research focuses on the development of algorithms for analysis and economic evaluation, with a view to devising context-based urban design scenarios. The proposed tools are expected to adhere to principles of adaptation and mitigation in relation to the dynamics of urban development and the evolution of the relevant knowledge systems: property market, natural capital, socio-cultural assets. The study will also explore the potential use of artificial intelligence for the automation of evaluation processes in dynamic urban contexts.

The study will focus on identifying the state of the art and exploring technological and usability trends, with an emphasis on design compatibility regarding existing production processes and product platforms within the sector. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Experimental validation of monitoring systems for rigid pavements and concrete elements based on embedded fiber optic sensing (Univ. ROMA TRE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 23:59
Institution: Univ. ROMA TRE, Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

The Research Group operating within the academic discipline of CEAR 03/A has constructed full-scale test sections under controlled conditions, in which the rigid pavements and concrete elements have been instrumented using FBG optical fibre sensors embedded directly into the concrete.The research activity covered by this call will therefore focus on validating the performance of the prototype system. Validation will be carried out through a statistical comparison of the experimental data with the results obtained using the main models available in the literature, including the Westergaard, Thomlison and FAA models.
